overview_description.description: Sweeps makes any website 40% faster with a single line of code, by optimizing how it loads third-party tools. This results in x2 conversion rates and better SEO rankings. Sweeps' third-party manager enhances web performance metrics across all industries: ecommerce, publishing, gaming, b2b and more. With its innovative web infrastructure companies can easily integrate all types of third-parties, such as data & analytics tools, marketing technologies, CRM, advertisement technologies, widgets, and more, without slowing down their websites.
